text: My favorite place to get french toast! My step son is a super picky eater and he loves the food here too. We've been coming here for a while now and have never been disappointed. The staff is always so friendly and polite. Another bonus is that the service is always super quick. Love coming here for brunch! Highly recommend this place!

Went to Mr. Ed's on Iberville street and had such an AMAZING dinner!!! Not only was the food absolutely delicious but our server Meldra was such a sweet heart and the manager Dale was so nice and polite and fun to talk to. Can't wait to go back!
My favorite Thai restaurant. Go there every time I come back to St. Louis. Spicy Basil with beef is fantastic

I almost never give 5 star reviews because I usually assume there's room for improvement, but our meal was perfection. We came to New Orleans for our baby-moon with the plan to eat what we hoped to be the best food, and G.W. Fins lives up to our expectations. We got the royal red shrimp, which was cooked perfectly and the glace had the perfect amount of tang. The heirloom tomato salad was delightful. I was initially worried about ordering a steak medium instead of medium rare, because of concerns of texture, and the steak was phenomenal. We split the Salty Malty Ice cream Pie, after a debate over it or the bread pudding, and we were very happy with our choice. Our server was very knowledgeable and helped us in food decision making (because it all looked so good).

Went to Subway yesterday and Lona did my sandwich and she was absolutely wonderful very friendly and my sandwich was absolutely wonderful I'm definitely coming back next week . Went today and misty did my sandwich and was absolutely wonderful I always enjoy when I see misty and Lona will be back on Friday

I know not to expect a whole lot from a fast food chicken restaurant but I happened to be in the mood and hadn't had Church's in a while so I went for it.  Sadly the best part of the meal was the packaging, very secure.  The chicken that was supposed to be all spicy pieces was mixed and dry, looking like it had been sitting under the heat lamp for hours.  My side of mac and cheese was barely half full in the small container and also looked old.  Eh I doctored up the food as best I could with some hot sauce and finished it off.  Lesson learned to go elsewhere.

I ordered mattar paneer, garlic naan, and gulab jamun via Grubhub for takeout.  Mattar paneer is my favorite indian dish, the paneer cubes, the tomato based sauce, the peas.  This one was average the gravy was a little on the light side and could have been a little more flavorful, also the container I got was the size of a soup appetizer not saying I need a giant serving but for $14.00 I expected a little more.  The garlic naan was as expected serving size was fine and it was fresh and still warm when I got it.  The gulab jamun dessert was the most disappointing, there were two balls in there for $5.50, I would have thought there would at least have been four or five it's not an extravagant expensive dessert to make and two seems really cheap.

I've been holding off on trying this place. Usually way too busy. I gave it a go tonight. I was happy with the food. The pot stickers were super tasty. The burger came out medium rare as ordered. Everything was seasoned in a fair manner (not over seasoned). Glad to see this place operating and acting as a competitor in town. Keep up the good work.

I rate 4 stars primarily because It's a decent restaurant with good food coming out. I'm not sure if "as good as it gets" would be a proper label compared to other restaurants in the nearby area. However if I could add an additional half star I would.
Come get takeout!! Awesome menu thursadaythru Saturday 4-8 during this pandemic look for menu on Facebook

First of all, I'm so full I can't even think straight. First and foremost, If you come here there's a shady hotel next door. Your first instinct may be to judge it, but now that I sat here, and I caught the itis-I can see why people were smart enough to book a stay for the night. 

Starting with the atmosphere, it was a little tightly packed but oddly comforting in a kitschy way. Our server Mina made my brother and my friend feel very welcome, and provided us with good service and laughs through the night. Any question we had, she answered and we never had to ask her for anything. The food came out quickly as well, and it came with all the proper utensils. 

Mina suggested we order the combo's for the best value and variety. I got combo B, and it was a great honestly a great choice. I was satisfied with the portions, and the value that we received. I plan on coming back if I'm in the area, or just want a seafood boil in a bag as a place like this is hard to find in Tampa.

Our weekly visit tonight-excellent! We laugh with Sang and Mathilda and let Jay know how excellent and enjoyable our meal is.  The Sea Urchin (Uni);was exceptional tonight!  Met new "family" member, Simon.  Miyong is always attentive. Mathilda makes perfect Tuna Munchkins. Always a special treat; never disappointed. Cannot forget Jung and Jake, happily married one year. We can always count on their smiles, sunny dispositions, excellent  Center City restaurant reviews and superb service

I would gladly give oasis 10 stars if I could! WOW. This place is a gem! The food is amazing and the  mole sauce is so good it will leave you wanting to lick the plate clean. Wait, I'm getting distracted because I'm salivating just thinking about that mole sauce. 
I apologize, let me start over. I have been to oasis before. Once with a friend and twice with my daughter. It's always been 10 stars!! Just never had the chance to review but last Sunday I was just blown away and I had tell you! It was May 5th so I wasn't expecting the best experience anywhere because of the crowds that would be flooding Mexican restaurants everywhere. Oasis has always been one of my favorite spots for yummy authentic Mexican this side of the bridge and the service has always been great too. I was in philly but was headed back to nj so I checked out open table to make a reservation while on the train back to nj. I made a reservation for 7:30 pm but I was still expecting a wait because oasis is small and it was cinco de Mayo. We walked in and the host asked us if we had a reservation. We told her yes and she walked us to a small table in back. The tables all had a small candle and on each table they had placed the name of the party and reservation time to ensure that you didn't wait!! We were sat immediately, no wait. Wow!. We ordered Drinks and the waitress brought our tortillas with the trio of sauces. I love that oasis puts a small amount of refried beans on the tortillas!! Always delicious. Our
Great place for meat +3. Friendly service and great selection. If u eat-in sometimes u get fresh baked cookies I wish this place took credit cards

Good family owned restaurant.  The pad thai and curries are on point any day is the week.  I've had the pad thai, pad see eew, drunken noodles, Bangkok noodles, pineapple friend rice, and I've had a few curries too.  If your planning on dining in, they have a a great selection of beer too.  The staff is amazing always getting the food out quickly and as promised on time if you do takeout.  Overall, good thai food for the price and location.

YES THE FIRST THREE MONTHS WERE ROCKY, BUT...
I spent some time talking to the delightful hostess at Dian before being seated. She is also the daughter of the owner who is also the chef. I asked her why they didn't have a lunch seating yet and she looked me straight in the eye and said: we aren't ready. 

I LOVE THEIR HONESTY
If you read the reviews, most negatives were from the beginning. She told me that the family was so unprepared for the huge interest in the business. How hard it was to stock and run operations in the Quarter as opposed to Kenner. They got in the weeds very quickly, her father lost 30 pounds and the family was miserable.  So they cut back and concentrated on a quality, manageable product.

HOW TO EAT DUMPLINGS
Her favorite traditional preparation is to pierce the bun in a ladle so that way the broth is in tact, then add a bit of the spicy vinegar.
LOVE this place! Friendly staff. The food was so good we went back two days in a row! Maybe will be going back for a third while in town

NOTE: I will have to try this place again once the lockdown is lifted. This review is based on takeout (which usually doesn't do any place justice)

I called and place an order for pick up. The process was very painless and quick. Once you're there you call them and they open up the shop for you to come in, pay, grab your order and leave.

I ordered the al pastor tacos with rice and beans and the BF ordered the cheese god chimichanga. Both items were just alright. Im not a vegan or a vegetarian and I know that vegan and vegetarian food will not be the same as meat. So, that being said, I was kind of expecting more based on the reviews but it didn't blow me away or really left anything desirable for me to want to come back. I will not go into detail about the specifics because again, take out during the Covid-19 doesn't do most places justice on their foods.

For right now now I will leave it at: this place wasn't bad, it could be more flavorful, hot sauce was yummy, I wasn't a fan of the horchata or the rice and beans (a little dry). BUT, I am willing to try this place again when it opens up for actual business. For now, I will not be back for take out during the Covid-19 lockdown.
Pretty dull. Figured with an expansive vegan menu it would be more than just tofu patties. Nice place tho.
This place sucks. Got the order wrong and the food wasn't up to par. Also the tables were very dirty. However the only reason this gets 2 stars is because a worker complimented my hair.

I went to this restaurant based on a friend's recommendation. I absolutely loved the Decor. Service was OK. Our waiter seemed busy towards the end of the meal. The food was good, we ordered brunch (Big Breakfast). The live entertainment was awesome! (At tad loud and hard to hear conversation with my boyfriend). The mimosas tasted different each time.. sometimes it had more juice or more champagne. I had to send one back because it literally tasted like juice. Overall, we had a good time.

I want to say, I wouldn't post a bad review of a restaurant after just one bad experience, but I've given this place 5 chances, and only once did they'd get my order correct. I order Stop Drop and Roll (medium) heat level each time. 3 times I got delivery, and every time it just came as fried chicken, no heat level whatsoever. One time I went inside to dine in and they got my heat level correct and it was great. Then today, I called in my order (stop drop and roll heat level) and when I went to go pick it up, I checked the box to make sure it was correct. Once again It was just fried chicken, no heat level at all. I told the woman running the counter that I think they messed up my order, there was no spice, it's just plain fried chicken. She said it was correct and all of the chicken all looks the same, you can't tell the heat level by the color of the chicken. To which I replied, that I have been here before and gotten this heat level and it was a darker red color. I then tasted it and told her that it doesn't taste hot at all. She would not admit that they got the order wrong so I went on my way as to not cause a disturbance for the other customers. I will absolutely never come back here again.

I've been meaning to check this place out for a while and was so glad we finally made it. I went on Sunday because it's unlimited play for like 9 bucks...any other day it's like $30...for table tennis...yeah AIGHT. So first off, the decor is a little overtop but it was funky. Plenty of tables but I would definitely advise bringing your own racket. Their rackets were all falling apart...like embarrassing to use foreal. Also, the rotating table thing was a bit unorganized but we made the most of it. They should have a TelePrompTer with table assignments or something. Overall, it was a good night.

Best all around pub in the entire Bay area,  Great staff, good food, good prices, good entertainment, and fantastic clientele.  My wife and I always have a blast a Finley's.  John the bartender is excellent, and the owners are the nicest people you could want to meet.  If visiting the area, stop in and have an authentic pub experience; if you live here, become a regular, you'll love it.
My husband and I sat outside and had a delicious dinner. Our waitress was great. Wonderful experience. I will definitely go back.

I ordered the matcha cream crepe cake. 

This is an interesting cake. It's a crepe folded up many times to create a layered cake filled between each layer with matcha cream.

This is a dessert that is on the lighter side.

I thought the matcha cream was too strong in its leafyness, and could have used a bit more fat and sugar.

However, the texture of the crepe cake falling apart on the palate was extremely enjoyable. And the crepes themselves were excellent in execution and flavor.

Yummmm date night was a success. We sat at the bar while waiting for seats. The food options were great, but remember the food is flown in daily so "market price" can get a bit pricey. The fried green tomatoes were to die for. The decor was very unique and seating was close, casual but still you had enough space to feel like you have to whisper. Parking was street side but the neighborhood was beautiful so the walk was pleasant. Definitely a must try

I think the reason they have a low rating at this location is from older reviews. 2-3 years ago they seemed to be going through a bad management phase or something. The customer service(getting your order right) and the food, both had gone downhill. I can attest that they have been back on top of their game the past year+. We order catering and visit for lunch,  every experience has been top-notch customer service and an abundance of fresh, delicious food!
Good food, very large variety with large quantities, fast service with food cooked to order, desert is to die for
Very disappointed in the service. Took 1.5 hours for the lunch to be served. Food was very good. If server is experienced, she needs to go back to training.

I ordered for this restaurant a substantial amount of food and when I came to pick it up I asked one of the staff If I was allowed to use their bathroom facilities. I was informed by a very rude woman that I was not allowed to use the bathroom. Normally I would have no issues with this but throughout the entire restaurant there where people with no masks on IN A PANDEMIC! This level of carelessness and bad customer service is inexcusable and if this is what was done in the front of the restaurant I can only imagine what takes place in the kitchen. Very disappointed will not be returning.
Food was outstanding! Service was amazing, curbside pick up was easy. Highly recommended.
Best avocado toast I've ever had! So flavorful! Definitely want to get it again! Friendly waitstaff and fun atmosphere too. They also have great dinners

This place is beyond amazing! Fresh, healthy, delicious, affordable. Today my friend had the Crack Chicken Bowl and I had the Veggie Sandwich and White Bean and Kale soup. The food is clean, colorful and gives the body life and energy!
We like to go to the one in sylvan park because their is always parking and the line isn't as long as midtown. I love the chicken and waffles and wish they were available everyday!

Cool little hipster pizza joint. Their lunch specials are well priced and you get a great portion of food for the price. We got there at the end of the lunch rush. We got our food pretty quickly but it took a while to check out, despite it being less crowded than when we got there

My husband and I live just miles from the Wesley Chapel Outback (located in The Grove) and we have been visiting this location for years. We have always had a good experience while dining, but lately - especially during COVID - the team at this location has been providing exceptional service and food. We have primarily been ordering curbside pickup and the full experience from ordering, pickup, and final product has been wonderful and right on point. Danielle and her team are phenomenal and we look forward to our regular Outback dinner orders. We love to give credit where credit is due, and in this case, it is definitely due and everyone there should be rewarded for their efforts. They have saved the day for us in several cases and we are thankful to have a reliable, high-quality restaurant near us.

Been here 4 times in the last week. I really like the food here and the people are nice. The space is thoughtfully decorated. During lunch it's nice and bright. Favorite thing so far are the fish tacos. The salads are huge. Tried many of the "snacks" and they were all good. The guac was good, but not stellar. The bean empanadas were yummy.

Went here for breakfast today.  Service was good, the food was good.  Unfortunately, while the service staff were all wearing masks and gloves, the social distancing for seating went out the window as the restaurant became busier.  Most of the customers seemed to be in the older, higher risk from Coronavirus infection, so this is a big fail.  Doubt we'll be back until all this gets resolved, which is a shame as we very strongly believe in buying local.
Amazing food and never disappoints!  Their bread is so good and made there as is their pasta.  If you love fresh pasta, this the place for you.  Always a great experience from the staff to the food.

When you enter STK, you will definitely find yourself asking "Am I Nashville or Vegas?" The dark interior with pops of white floral displays make you feel like you are in an upscale restaurant/club. Welcome to the new Nashville. It doesn't hurt that they have a DJ booth and multi-levels, with a large bar on the side of the restaurant. I like what they did with the space, keeping the beautiful lighting from the previous restaurant and building around it. The staff was friendly and helpful, and quickly offered us a wine list in addition to the cocktail list already propped up on the table. Drinks are expensive, the cheapest wine is $14 a glass, and the cocktails are $16 each, but good luck trying to find that on the menu. It's comical how small it is; printed on flesh colored paper in cursive in the tiniest font ever. Check out my photos, it's pretty amusing. I opted for a $15 sauvignon blanc and my BF ordered a flavored margarita cocktail that was OK and in a pretty small glass. I stuck with wine. The dinner menu (you guessed it) is also pricey, with salads, starters, seafood platters, steak, and entrees with a decent selection of sides. We ordered the hearts of palm and crab salad, the mini burgers, and the whole branzino to share. First off they sent us complimentary bread with blue cheese butter and a dipping sauce that was pretty good, but nothing spectacular. The salad came out promptly but we couldn't find any crab. It was left off, so we had to send it back. At first th
Ordered tonight to go and the food was disgusting. Cold and soggy. Fries were still partially raw.

If I could go lower the one star I would. The food was cold . And they for got to put utensils in my to go bag . Had to eat the food with my dam hands cause didn't have access to a fork and knife smh .The food was horrible and looks like something I would feed to my dog. NEVER again will I order from this place learned my lesson .
Excellent food, comfortable venue, pleasant staff.  Have eaten Sunday brunch and other meals, all good!

DO NOT EAT HERE.

The service is terrible, the takeout is terrible and the food is cold. Waited an hour and a half for my meal and it was cold. When i demanded for my money back the management said "it's not our fault!" 

DO NOT EAT HERE!!!
Amazing place open late! Best Cuban sandwich ever! They make their own bread! Amazing servers!

Excellent food! Excellent CUSTOMER SERVICE.

Ordered Chicken Pizza Cheesesteaks. Plain Chicken Cheesesteaks arrived.

I called and was transfered to manager. I asked for Pizza sauce to be sent. 

MANAGER personally showed up with order RE-MADE! Correct and HOT! Oh my God it was perfect.

The manager said 'It was our mistake, so not your problem!' 

That IS customer service!!
SOOOO good, amazing sandwiches that are so yummy and filling. The psycho chicken and the blue heeler (without blue cheese) are both great!

Ordered a single order of potstickers over the phone for pickup. As the online menu still states the potstickers are served with fried rice, I was expecting 6 potstickers and 1 side of fried rice for 8.50$. When I picked up my food, I was told "no fried rice anymore". The explanation was that everything "has gone up". So, a warning: if you order the potstickers, you're only getting 6 potstickers for over 8$. That's over 1$ per potsticker. They need to update their menus.

I like this place because it's open late. However the food is not great. The Buffalo chicken dip is pretty gross with almost no chicken and way too much blue cheese in it. Their mac & cheese says you could add lobster but they don't have lobster. The colonels  chicken bowl has beef gravy. Why the hell would you put beef gravy in a chicken bowl? I don't eat beef so I won't be ordering that. Since they ruined it with beef gravy.
They also have chicken breasts Entrées for $16 but they don't come with any sides. What?! $16 for an entrée with no sides?! No thanks. Almost no healthy options for food either. Which is unfortunate.. 
Two months ago me and my friend actually had dinner here. Service was extremely slow. I don't remember the waitresses name but it took her 10 minutes to bring ketchup. Seems like that's a big problem with this place and the majority of the complaints

The absolute worst! Can I not post less than 1 Star? First time ordered from there the chicken fingers and fries were rubbery. Second time I ordered a pizza and they told me it would take 25 minutes. I arrived exactly 25 minutes and they told me they were just putting it in the oven when I got there. Fed me a couple BS lines.  First was they just got hit with a post Eagles game rush. But my favorite, in the same visit mind you, was they put the pizza in the oven when the customer arrives so it's nice and fresh for the customer. Not only was I pissed my food wasn't ready but now they're insulting my intelligence. Not to mention the obnoxious car revving it's engine for a half hour every night between 10-11pm and the kid that keeps coming around on his little illegal motorbike circling their parking lot. PLEASE SHUT THIS CIRCUS DOWN!

BEST TACOS!
Amazing service
Favorite place locally.

This is by far the worst Dunkin' I've ever been to. Reasons why: 

1. Their store hours claim they close at 9pm. I've been by more than once around 8pm, a full hour sooner, and I've come across employees just leaving doe the day. At 8. If they're not leaving, they're already gone. Seriously. Made an online order and pulled up to nothing. Silence. Pull around to the window and no one is there at all. App says their open. Sign on the front window shines "open" but apparently the employees had other ideas? Bs. 

2. Orders being correct are hit or miss. I suppose it depends on the time of day you go and who is on duty. Sometimes th worker is right. Others it's so wrong it's laughable. 

3. Customer service is terrible. Recently ordered just a coffee and am told to pull around. I do so only to be greeted by a female employee eating something. For the next 3-5 minutes she just sat there and ate right in full view of me. She eventually got my coffee and claimed "we made it fresh". No. You just ate your breakfast before getting it to me. Thanks? 

THE ONLY reason I think anyone goes here is the convenience of location. If another one opened up a few blocks or even a mile away no one would go here. They need a complete overall of employees and/ or training. Also, don't close an hour early just because you don't feel like working. If you want to close at 8 then list the hours as so. 

The Camden location on mount emphraim Ave is WAY better than this location despite where it is. 

Hope

Had breakfast this morning here. First time for breakfast. The waitress Jessica was outstanding. There was an easy error when I escorted my little guy to the restroom one of the employees started cleaning off my table.  An easy error, no harm done. She made sure our experience was outstanding. The food was incredible. I really appreciate the service here. I've seen some other reviews. The service was not slow. It was efficient and a great experience.

All the roles were very delicious! 
The server was very sweet. The food came out very quickly. Nice dance/club music inside and outdoors.

We love stake and shake and thought it would be a good cheep eat. The menu is much smaller to the point the meal I normal order isn't available and there was no specials. Our server Tuseday greeted us and we asked for a few moments to look over the menu changes. She came back less than a minute later making us feel rushed and unwelcomed. Also Durning the meal we could hear the servers not waiting to be at work due to low volume and wanting to be cut. It was clear they are over staffed but those complaints should be saved for the back. Getting a drink refill was also something that I was worried I would receive. I do not recommend this location

Our first visit  to Ocean Prime ever  and my husband and I were celebrating my birthday!  We had a reservation and yet were seated in the middle of a crowded noisy large dining room room. Babies and toddlers at nearby tables!  Not cozy or pleasant at all for just the two of us!!  The food was good but not the best I've ever had for the high prices they charge!   The Devour Indy portions are modest to say the least. Since there are many other choices Indy I'll opt for another restaurant next birthday!!  You should too!

The worst Italian restaurant in Doyelstown. Actually the worst restaurant in Bucks County. The cook staff do not wear face masks. I ordered linguini al dented. I had to send it back, as it was about as hard as a rock. Our party of 4 arrived at 7PM and we were the only ones there. Our waiter kept removing his mask. Have you not heard of COVID19? We will never eat at your restaurant and neither will our friends.

I think this place is probably in the top 5 burger spots in Indy. They have a very interesting menu that is totally customizable. Every topping, sauce and cheese imaginable. The standard beef burger is a nice patty that they season very well, but i think the Duck burger with teriyaki their best. I'm not a huge fan of their sides as the waffle fries are just ok and I'm not a fan of sweet potato tots.

Great service at the bar and the bone in ribeye was perfectly cooked. We had come about two years ago and it was pretty average. Seems like they got their act together and deserve a great review and they need to be on their game with competitors in their back yard. Bartenders were personable and accommodating. Nice work team.

When I was on my way to the rental car lot from the St. Louis, the lovely lady driving recommended Pappy's. Although we were traveling to an area away from St. Louis, we had some time to spare so we drove to Pappy's. I wish that I could leave a review higher than 5 stars, they deserve it. We walked in, and were promptly handed a menu on the way to getting in line to order. After a quick scan, I decided to get the Ribs, combo'd with a 1/4 lb of brisket with sweet potato fries and baked beans. The ribs were AMAZING, there was not a speck of meat on the bones after I was done. The brisket was sliced thin and perfect for sampling their four choices of BBQ sauce. You wouldn't guess it, but their sweet potato fries are some of the best that I have ever tried. The baked beans were the icing on top, they were fantastic as well. If I am ever in St. Louis again, I will do everything I can to stop here again!

My nephew recommended this restaurant while we were visiting his mom in the hospital. I and my husband ordered 3 dinners of oxtails with rice and gravy, cabbage and yams to go. I was thoroughly disappointed! I make much better oxtails, cabbage and yams. Definitely not worth the $19 my husband payed for each meal! The oxtails were not cooked thoroughly and had way too much rubbery fat and maybe one tablespoon of meat in the entire meal! He payed for 5/8 inch cut oxtails with little to no meat! The gravy was definitely not homemade or Southern cooked. The cabbage was overcooked and under seasoned. The yams were definitely canned and nothing Southern other than the large amount of sugar! To top it off  they forgot to include the sweet potato pie and banana pudding my hubs ordered. When he called back a child answered the phone and was very impolite in telling him they were closed. We are from Tallahassee and will be leaving in the morning with a very bad taste from this place! Take more pride in the food you cook and sale! Make sure its desirable enough for the customers to leave a highly rated review, tell other and at least want to return. Patty Lee

Whenever I feel a little stuffy all I want is pho. I've noticed there's a few different pho places so I really need to do a pho tour. On this occasion we chose Pho Tasty and was it ever! I got the rare beef pho and it was so flavorful. They had your normal toppings and sauces but they also had put a housemaid garlic pepper hot paste. It was spicy but it was so delicious. Seriously such a great bowl of pho. I was a little apprehensive when we first arrived and our waitress was outside the front smoking. I really hate that and wish there would be a place out back for such thing. We arrived and were the only ones there which also made me nervous. As soon as we ordered 5 other tables got filled so you know this place is happening if they fill up that fast! I'll definitely be returning!

Good food at a good price but the people making the food don't wear masks! we're in the middle of a pandemic, the least they can do is put on a mask if they're cooking and in close proximity with our food. Will not be returning until they can learn to wear a mask!!

This place is awesome. My wife got to choose any restaurant she wanted for her birthday today and she was feeling like a nice casual place. This is the first place she suggested. I've been here before but being a non-meat eater, it's a little difficult. Their pork gyro is so good. I broke last time and I figured I would treat myself again for her birthday. If you're going to eat meat, might as well enjoy the hell out of it. I was not disappointed. My wife got the veggie gyro and I got the pork/lamb platter. We split an order of lemon potatoes. Everything was outstanding, but I highly recommend the pork sandwich or platter with lemon potatoes on the side. Great place, give it a try! 

Sincerely 

Chris

My boyfriend said I needed to start this review with "their food is phenomenal!!!!" What an awesome spot we found. Outdoor seating with string lights, and beautiful  palm trees lined the dining area.The music was good-loud, but not too loud. Exactly what I had been missing for this weekend.  I ordered the chicken pita, and my boyfriend got the pulled pork sandwich. My pita was awesome. The chicken was quality you could taste.  And cooked so well, Perfect flavor!! And the pita was so fresh!!! My boyfriend could not stop raving to our server about how good his was his. With the pulled pork, you also got pickles and Cole slaw- on a toasted bun.  what a perfect combination! The fries were also quite tasty. I thought the food here was the best out of anywhere else we have tried in the area. And I loved the vibe! It kind of reminded me of key west. Anyways, thank you again for the awesome food! We will be back every-time we are in the area to visit ! Our server was awesome too.
I had the fried anchovies as an appetizer. Spicy and crisp.  The goat curry with a side of garlic naan was one of the best I had.  Spicy, tender meat and full of flavor.

Super convenient to the hotel I was staying at. The milkshake and fries were delicious. They accommodated my request to leave sprouts off the Earth Burger, which was also good. Very reasonably priced. Plenty of seating inside and outside.

Delicious and lots of options! Ready for vegans, gluten free folks, carnivores-- just about any dietary need you could imagine: they can accommodate. We especially liked the agedashi tofu (very gingery and bright)!

Thank you for the delicious sandwiches!!  Our laboratory staff at Bayfront Health-St. Petersburg thanks you for your generous and thoughtful gesture.  This is my first time trying a vegan sub sandwich and I loved it!  The flavors were perfect together.

WoW! This place rox! Went there with family and this place cannot be beaten. Walk in at 10 and take out or eat in quickly b/c as it approaches lunch time this place is kicking. I have never had a Philly Cheese steak worthy of ranting about until here. Very small, unassuming, just kind of a hole in the wall, u can see the owner grilling, nice gal works up front counter-idk I cannot say a bad thing about this place. We did eat in one time, very basic and small seating. Great if you need to just sit and eat or I would recommend you take it out with you! Fantastic food! Clean, affordable what more can I say~!

Yes! So good. I love pizza and this is just heaven!
Great location, awesome staff too!
Very yummy and comfort food. It's not to heavy and great flavor! Very happy we found this little gem!
Neighborhood gem.  Delicious breakfast sandwiches.  Can't wait till they are back up to full service.
Lovely place yummy food great service specially for our first time and we being vegetarian  this is going to be one of our favourites

This is a family favorite! There happy hour is buy one get one. For drinks. We all have our favorites for food. Mussels for some, conch fritters for others. I personally always get the raw oysters or Greek salad (with beets) but we always have a good meal here when in the FLA

Great lentil soup, mom's recipe. Their beef and chicken shawarma is out of the planet. They go perfect with the sauces. And the rice is also tasty. Will definitely come back. 
They don't have many vegetarian options. I tried one and it wasn't good, mostly just eggplant.

We loved our dining experience here! The service was excellent and the food was phenomenal. We went during covid times and fortunately they have plenty of heat lamps to keep you warm. I highly recommend this restaurant, especially for groups!

If I want a fresh, delicious salad, Newk's is my go-to place! The salads served here are huge! I love the Newk's favorite salad, the grapes with chicken and their vinaigrette...yummy! They have good pizza and soups that you have to try too!

I have been to Newk's multiple times since quarantine began and have always felt comfortable eating there, especially on the patio. I've tried 3 different salads and they were all great but the tastiest item by far was the the Newk's Q sandwich. Great service on each visit - this place is a gem!

So amazing. Best fried chicken sandwich I've ever had. Topped with delicious mac and cheese! Obviously this isn't something you can eat frequently, but when you want to really treat yourself, this is the place to go

I came here for a breakfast meeting. This is not a bad location for taking work meetings because it was fairly empty and quiet when I was there and you have a lot of space to yourself. You order at the counter and they'll carry it out to you. I ordered an egg and bacon biscuit which came with pico de gallo on top which I liked. It also came out very fast. I wouldn't say the food blew me away but I liked how chill the cafe was. I would go back here for that reason alone.

Great neighborhood restaurant.  Locals eat here, but so can tourists.  My favorites are the chicken wings, soft shell crab tacos, and a sangria.  Tonight I tried the homemade churros with chocolate and caramel sauce.  They were delicious!  Just the right amount of sugar and cinnamon.  Great service.  Very attentive.  Huge patio for outside dining and the dining room is spacious, but intimate.  If you are a local stop by at least once.  If you are a tourist, check out this gem.

An amazing French bakery plus cafe. The almond croissant are incredible as is every single pastry that Jerome makes.  Thank goodness I don't live down the block otherwise I would be gaining weigh every day. Thank you Jerome for all your hard work.

The food here is delicious, I always get their chicken alfredo with broccoli. The drinks are good and their liquor is not cut. On weekends its busy but if you're looking for a nice lounge with relaxing music come during happy hour. I'm celebrating my bday here so im very excitedxx

Long ago, when I was still a youthful lad, I remember my burgerwizard Uncle sharing his burger creed with me, saying "If it doesn't take two hands to hold it, I don't want it." Remarkable, I know. While this life motto probably didn't help his weight issues and health problems, it did often times make for a great family cookout. Which brings me to Divine Bovine Burgers. I feel they make a burger my Uncle would be proud to partake of. 

Full disclosure, I've visited here twice and both times ordered the same burger. I like what I like. Wanna fight about it? I saw the farmers burgers with pork belly and I went for it. A tasty patty crowned with slice of cheese. Thick strips of bacon. Some pickles. Stack some potato chips on top because who needs a side of chips when you can throw them in the burger. Is there room for more? Yup! Throw a fried egg on top so breakfast isn't left out and finish it with some sauce. Epic stuff.

My friend tried a different burger (can't remember which) and enjoyed his selection as well. Food is not cheap but you won't leave hungry. The service was very friendly and the cooks even asked how we liked certain items, besides the patty, cooked. A solid spot for two-hand burgers. Burgerwizard Uncle approved. 4.5/5*
Their gourmet flatbread pizzas are great. Our favorite pizza in the Boise area. They also pour a good size drink. I love their lasagna. Also good salads.

Forget Chik-Fil-A, forget Beethoven, Forget your whole life until this point: this Blaze pizza is flameo hotman. If you ain't catching my lingo, this Blaze is nothing short of excellence. A raging inferno of superb customer service is contained within the walls of this establishment, with Diego vehemently fanning the flames. If you elect to get a pizza here, I applaud your wise decision. Because it's fire, you won't get burned, and they make sure that they become your new flame  (:
Love to have a yummy bakery nearby instead of the supermarket stuff.  Their stuff is fresh and homemade. I LOVE GOING THERE!

Never thought I'd order (let alone love) a breakfast salad, but here we are. It had been a heavy beer-filled long weekend for us and my body was begging me to order something from the "Lite" menu section and so the Sunshine salad with greens, potatoes, poached egg (and more) called my name. As far as salads go, it was super flavorful with the perfect amount of dressing. Potatoes were delicious and I loved the crunch and sweet bursts of the pomegranates. I'm also a sucker for anything with an egg on top. 

My husband got the Rollex and loved it. It totally would've been my second choice. 

Very busy on a Sunday morning at 11am, but we were able to find a table for 2 outside. 

Counter service style and very friendly service.
Food is good, service is slow and servers tend to act like they are put out with simple requests.

When you walk into Cuba Libre, you'll feel like you've been transported to an island paradise, away from the fast-paced city streets. The staircase along the wall leads to a balcony with tables that overlook the first floor of restaurant. The lazy moving paddle fans hanging from the ceiling contribute to the overall lax but lively atmosphere of the restaurant. Part of a restaurant experience is the overall atmosphere and interior design and this place easily excels in both areas.

Food and Drink Ordered:
* worth trying

- [Malanga Fritters]: I was expecting the taro on the inside to taste smooth rather than grainy but it was interesting to try and I would recommend everyone to try it at least once. 

- [Vacio Steak "Argentino"]: I'm not much of a steak person so when I say that I didn't like it, don't take my word on it. However, the moros y cristianos (black beans and rice pilaf) it came with were really good, especially with the pickled okra on top. The tostones (twice-fried plaintains) were too hard and dry for my liking.

- [Tres Leches]: This was very rich, which isn't usually what I want in a dessert, so I personally wouldn't recommend it.

- [Guava Caipirinhas*]: Besides not being much of a steak eater, I'm also not much of a drinker but I would recommend this drink. I barely tasted the alcohol and the guava taste was so juicy. I tried a bit of my friend's classic mojito and that was good as well. Very refreshing.    

Would I go back? : Although my review of the food

I order the Saag Paneer from here all the time and it's fantastic. Probably my favorite Saag Paneer I've tried at a restaurant in Philly. Also, my orders are always delivered super promptly (always ahead of the scheduled ETA) (thank you GrubHub drivers). I also love the dahi vada!! 

Super tasty, reasonably priced food!

I love this place! The staff is always awesome and so laid back! They make it a great place to go if you want to be surrounded by good vibes! Another plus... they make the BEST Grateful Dead! I would definitely recommend this place to anyone!

Went here last night for the first time and had a great experience. The restaurant was clean, the service was good, and the food was wonderful.  Even my husband, who has been avoiding trying Indian food, liked it.

Very good menu selection, I have had the heart attack roll, Who dat roll, Fuji three roll which of all been good. The crab and cheese spring roll is also very good. The ingredients are fresh and the prices are reasonable. Will definitely be getting food from here again.b

Stopped by for a quick breakfast and so glad I did!  This place is adorable, service was great, and food was good.

We will be back to try lunch or dinner.

Visited this cozy looking place but it wasn't worth the ride to go there. I tried the steak, chorizo and chicken tinga tacos while here. The best by far was the chorizo taco. Juicy, flavorful and the best by far. The tortilla was filled just right, not at all skimpy on filling but a rip off to pay .50 extra for each  lettuce, tomato or cheese if wanted on taco. If you want limes for your food, guess what, it's extra. Rip off.
The so called salsa is a bland version of pico de gallo as well as the guacamole. Tortilla chips were just ok. Not worth what they charge for them. Maybe because everything is bigger and flavorful in Texas. ; ) this is not anything to write home about.
They have two hot sauce bottles, a green version and a red version with no flavor even though the red is spicier.
Waitress seemed to not want to be there and acted like we were a bother. Not very busy when we arrived. 
I'm sure there are way better taco places in PA but this is just my opinion. I wouldn't go back and those that say this is a great place probably have never been to real taco places.

From the tableside guacamole, to the steaks, to the seabass, to the carrot cake the size of my head... this local gem ticks all the boxes, and kills their corporate competition. Keep it up, Flamestone. Huge thanks to Peter and Zach for always making a guest feel welcome, and chef Jarvis for his creativity
I ordered the chicken fettuccine and my husband got the pizza. The fettuccine has what appeared to be boiled chicken chunks in it. The pizza was oily and under cooked. We definitely will not be back.

First time here. Prices great, saw half price wine on Wednesday's. Wife is gluten free, tons of options. I had the mud cat Mac and cheese. Awesome dish!  Good solo guitar on fri night. Katlin was our server, lots of fun!  Definitely will be back!

This restaurant was highly recommended by a friend and my wife and I decided to try it out. When we arrived, they said it would be 25 min wait to dine outside. After 30 mins they told us it would be an hour and wanted us to dine inside. After I told the host we have been waiting 30 mins, he found a place outside. It was a nice spot, a musician playing, beautiful night. We ordered soup and calamari for appetizers and salmon for dinner. After waiting nearly an hour and seeing the table next to us who arrived 10 mins after we were seated,  get their dinner, I asked the waiter to make it to go. The food was not edible. The calamari was not good and the salmon was like cardboard...overcooked by 5 mins. The food was likely sitting under a hot lamp for 15 mins. Needless to say, the romantic night out was so much so. Poor planning by manag6as they had several large parties and not enough staff too.
Just came here to say how great the bread pudding was! Definitely leave room for it. This is a nice atmosphere and the our server was really nice.

I just ordered take out. Got Egg rolls, Rainbow Curry Noodle Soup, and a Best Friends Sushi Burritto. AAAAAMAZING. This place just made it to the once or twice a week club. The egg rolls were crisp and beautiful. The Rainbow Curry Noodle Soup with Shrimp was an explosion of great flavors with the fresh mint and coconut and rice noodles. The Best Friends Sushi Burrito was so right on the money. Not quite big enough for a man appetite by itself but if you like sushi, you will love this.  I know I'm gushing but I love good food and take food quite seriously, so when a restaurant delivers something more than just "good" food and steps over into the exciting category, I must sing their praise. La la la, I'm singing.
Cannot customize my pho to another noodle. She was really rude about it. Even though it was busy doesn't mean the quality of the food/service should be bad. I wouldn't recommend this place.

Time to update!

Had the chance to visit during COVID-19 and I was very pleased with the safety regulations the entire team implemented. Everyone was wearing masks, all tables were socially distant, and they were cleaning in-between diners.

I went with a friend and had some small bites and champagne. They actually have a champagne bottle for $20 and it definitely paired nicely with their creme brulee.

I've had a few visits pre-covid and my updated review was long overdue.

Terrible!! 

An over two hour nightmare for dinner!!

Server spilled ice on my daughter, was slow to bring drinks and keep them refilled.. it took over an hour for appetizers and salad , our meals looked like they had been thrown together with leftovers.  When asking for the manager, he blamed the kitchen, and never appeared again.  Then they forgot our desserts, etc etc... we won't be back!! 

Our once favorite place has now become our  least favorite. Carmine's or Bucci de Peppi it is for our family.

One of my favorite spots in my neighborhood. Their vast craft beer selection covers all the bases and then some. Staff has been helpful with finding particular beverages whenever I've had questions. I also love dining in here. Super laid back atmosphere and lots of great specials on different days of the week. I've had various styles of tacos, sandwiches, and burgers, all of which have been delicious. I haven't been here since the whole coronavirus thing, but I plan on placing a craft beer order soon for pickup as I am craving some of the things that only they seem to carry.

Dino's is a hidden gem tucked away under the Pontchartrain Expressway.

I've always driven past this establishment and it's quirky little signed, but never was tempted to enter. Well a friend and I were hungry one night and wanted so something low-key. So, we walked from his Warehouse District condo to Dino's.

To our surprise, once we walked in the place was surprisingly clean and definitely not what we pictured. The bartenders greeted us right away, told us to sit where we like.

We both had burgers, which hit the spot. What you'd expect from a typical bar/diner, but better. 

Would definitely return.

I have had this spot on my list to try for a while and met a friend that was in town here for dinner. The restaurant is elegant, clean, and modern inside with padded bar stools and booths throughout the space. The menu feels bit like tapas style dining so we decided to share a few dishes so that we could try more of the menu. The result was a mix of good and just OK. The good was the cheesesteak egg rolls and crab pasta! I knew the crab pasta was popular and truly would say it was quite delicious! The cheesesteak egg rolls weren't as fried or greasy as the ones I've had at other restaurants but still packed delicious flavor! The just OK for us were the brussel sprouts and broccoli and avocado side dishes. The broccoli was a bit boring and the brussels were flavorful but just not our cup of tea (too much chili!). That being said the menu is so diverse that I was surely be back so that I can try more items.

Great service, very friendly! If you're someone who's into outdoor dining this is definitely a great breakfast/brunch location. My only regret is that I didn't see they had patio seating available which was my fault, they did have a big sign near the register ‍. Great seating inside and out, avocado sandwich was my choice (5 stars). They're beignet we're pretty good, decent variety to choose from!!
They suck... at everything...unprofessional for drive thru. Waited forever for a simple nuggets order...nobody else was in the restaurant.

Food was absolutely amazing! We are visiting from Jacksonville and looking for something to eat. We don't eat Indian food often and forgot the names of certain dishes. but the owner was very patient and helped us and described the menu. The food came up quickly, it tasted like home cooking! We will definitely be coming back soon!

What an amazing place.  I moved here 2 years ago and go there 4 times a week.   Great food great variety.   Meat and fish shops, never a bad experience.  I highly recommend.   Amazing ribs in the far back west corner.

The best. Visiting family from out of state, took 13 and 11 year old baseball player. Easy, affordable, entire family had a blast. We have nothing like this in CA and we do the baseball circuit. Will definitely be back.

We were in the area looking for a place to grab a drink after dinner and found this place. We were traveling for work so we weren't familiar with the area. 

Since we had already eaten, we didn't get any food. We grabbed a table at the bar area. It was pretty crowded for a Monday night. 

The service was pretty slow. Our waitress seemed to disappear when we were ready to get our checks. 

It was pretty loud inside and hard to hear anything. It felt like a very commercialized brewery/restaurant, not really a local craft brewery. 

Overall, nothing was terrible, this just wasn't quite what we were looking for.

Think of the old saying, "You get what you pay for." The Bacara resort is a perfect example of this. This place is not for the budget minded guest, however if you are fortunate enough to spend more, then this is certainly a place you want to stay. Again, I will state it is not inexpensive, but it is completely worthy of the price premium. The grounds are beautiful, and depending on your room location, you can be a few steps from Haskell's Beach. To be very clear, this is a public beach, not exclusive to Bacara. There are locals/non-guests who are at the beach as well (I am not 100% certain on how they get in, perhaps a nearby parking lot?). Nevertheless, the beach is beautiful and offers plenty of space for leisure enjoyment. 

The standard rooms are nice but simple, I recommend if you are either splurging for this place, or are accustomed to the finer things, then opt for the 1 bedroom suite, or higher. I stayed in a 1 bedroom suite, and it was large, and very upscale and attention to detail exemplifying luxury. It offered a living room with separate dining area and a full dining table, a separate office room, and 2 bathrooms. The main bath offers a separate tub and shower, and the room was overall spacious. My room had a partial ocean view, you could hear the waves crashing ashore, and was steps from the beach. I could walk from my room to the beach within literally 2 minutes, or less depending on how fast you walk. The Bacara property offers many beautiful walking trails.
Delicious poke bowls, chicken teriyaki, and appetizers (gyoza and shrimp shu mai). Have not had a bad experience yet only awesome food. Reasonably priced as well!
First time.. but, no the last time . It's been a long time since ive had a burger this good! I'll be back

I love Einstein Bros! The bagels are phenomenal. I ordered a chocolate chip bagel with turkey and cheese w/ butter. My family ordered the Nova Lox, Farmhouse, and another bagel with just plain cream cheese and they all loved it. Also, the staff is incredibly friendly. The girl working this morning (3/12 at 9:45AM) with short brown hair not only asked me questions that I didn't even know that I wanted to specify (better tasting bagel, yay) but she was smiling and kind while doing it. The other gentlemen in the back and running food were also smiling and kind while delivering it to our table. This is much better than the USF location, I will definitely be returning.

Every time I come here it's me against the crowd. They allow any female to push her way to the front and don't care. It's getting annoying since I always come here. They do not care about others and push them to the back regardless of the situation, I'm about to stop coming here.

If you or someone you know has the number, you need to go visit this gem! 

Incredible speakeasy with a dress code. Their website has all the information you need. 

Each time I've come into Red Phone Booth, I've been blown away!! The bourbon, cigars, food, the staff, everything is spectacular!! 

Came in here for the first time on a date night, then a quick cocktail on the way home, then a get together before New Years! 

Tremendous Date night spot and a great place to smoke cigars with your friends and kick back!

This restaurant looked interesting and we made a reservation.  Fortunate for us because it was very full.  We were early enough on a weekday night to order off the early bird menu.  We had ravioli, veggie cerviche, hummus all at a great price, and risotto off the regular menu.  Wine list looked interesting but I was driving that night.

Ordered delivery online and doordash delivered promptly. I've seen reviews complaining about in person service, but I'd done an end run around that issue.

Wings were first class as always. They have enough sauces to please anyone.

So why not 5 stars? I should've slipped the fries.  No one's fault but my own, but fries go downhill quickly. From now on I won't be including them in delivery orders.

I've been here twice.  The staff is friendly and is quick to greet and seat you when you come in.  The first time I came in for dinner and it was great.  Generous portions and great service.  The second time I came in for a late breakfast.  (They serve breakfast all day).  Food came out about 10 minutes later which astounded us that they could cook our large order so quick.  The food was great, we ate and paid.  Got home and about a half hour later I had some serious diarrhea.  My friend who dined with me had the exact same issue.  I am going to assume there is some connection between the speedy service and our dietary indiscretion. .
I'm not a Ramen connoisseur, but the Ramen here was delicious! I've been back multiple times since first visit, the soup is consistently Yummy!

Usually great experiences at this BWW, but last night was brutal. Food was wrong, brought out at different times,waited for 15 with and empty glass and waited for another 25 minutes for drink to arrive (yes, 40 total minutes), had a waitress who didn't seem to care...spoke to manger, Elizabeth, who was clearly overwhelmed and didn't have any interest in fixing the situation.
Guys. Guyssss. This place is ah-mazing! If you are a corn on the cob lover get the Mexican street corn. Wow! Also, the torta Cubana
Top 5 on Main Street! Salmon entree is ridiculously good, spicy meatballs, Lisa's pizza, all the desserts... pair with a bottle of red and have a happy night.

I am not going to lie, if you were to drive into the strip mall that Oakleys Bistro resides in, you wouldn't think much of it but very happy that we gave it the chance it deserves. After all, you can't judge a book by its cover and boy does this place have all the surprises inside. 

The space is super warm and inviting inside and plenty of Covid protocols in place which made for a more enjoyable night knowing we were dining out safely. Owned by the famous Chef Steven Oakley. He wanted to create an experience that shows you don't need a special occasion to enjoy good affordable food. The creativity with their menu and plating was a fun journey on its own. Candied Bacon hanging from clothes pins? Prime rib dumplings? Shrimp corndogs? Meatloaf from a secret family recipe? This place literally had it all. There were so many starters and sharables, we ended up just doing a "tapas" style night because there were so many things we wanted to try. It is a great place to do this as well because the portions are the perfect size for multiple courses. We for sure want to go back though to obviously try our favorites again, but also try one of the entrees because we hear the meatloaf and beef short ribs are not to be missed!

Would recommend reservations because they did fill up pretty quickly. They also have a cool chefs table I'd be curious about reserving with a group. I am going to be on the look out for the wine dinners they host as well because their February one looks pretty epic

This spot is hopping with with deliciousness. The blackened shrimp tacos- three large juicy shrimps on a little corn tortilla - really good, but missing some spicy salsa or quac.  The birria quesadilla is stuffed with cheese and this slow braised tender shredded beef that's served with a side of hot, salty dipping sauce that's rich in gelatin and flavor from the stewed beef.  The redness on the outside of the flour tortilla is probably from the oil of the cooking liquid, so it's full of flavor. Lastly, the carne asada quesadilla was stuff with tender beef and cheese.  We didn't have any eating utensils and it got messy at times. It was a little hard to order from the window since it seemed that they had issues with hearing the order.

Went there with high hopes with my family. Received a mediocre meal and paid 50 dollars for just three dish. Everything tastes bad and service was average. Will be staying away from this crap rip off place

Had a most disappointing dinner as did our companions. Two of us had the strip steak, ordered medium rare and served well done and chewy. My wife had the pork, served barely warm and sauce congealing. Another dinner had the scallops which they thought were well prepared so one out of four nicely prepared. The best part was the warm freshly baked bread. Our waiter was friendly enough but never checked to see if our meals were to our satisfaction. I could go on about how disappointed we were given the ambiance is special and this place could be a fantastic place to dine. I hope they find a better kitchen team or new ownership to take this wonderful building to the next level. Call me disappointed.

While having our dinner I was watching the waitresses roll up silverware. It wouldn't have got my attention normally but 1. They were not wearing gloves. 2. They were picking it up by the business end. And 3. The grossest part one of them dropped a fork in her crotch area picked it up and wrapped it up anyway!!! Don't know about all of you but this seems disgusting to me. What else could they be touching with bare hands?

This place used to be pretty solid but they have started taking their profit margin way more seriously than good food and service.  The burger patties have gotten smaller, the burgers and drinks have all gotten more expensive.  Don't expect to leave for less than $20/person with a burger and a non-alcoholic drink.  $6.50 for their cheapest draft

Something was disturbingly wrong with the food we received. 

The food WAS delivered hot & packaged well. We ordered the Yum-Yum Chicken, General Tso's Chicken, and the Crab Rangoon. We ordered these items based on the reviews and recommendations of folks on Yelp & NextDoor.    

The good: they do provide cutlery, soy sauce packets, and fortune cookies. The food was packaged well and prepared quickly. The white rice is good. My husband liked his spring roll.

The bad: the Yum-Yum Chicken was actually inedible. The texture was kind of chewy (fatty...maybe?) but definitely not how chicken is supposed to be prepared. It wasn't crispy at all. The sauce was a fish sauce (call me crazy but isn't Yum-Yum Chicken supposed to be a Yum-Yum sauce? It seriously wasn't anything but a fish sauce.) It wasn't that I hate fish sauce that made it inedible, it was the texture. It was offensive to the senses. It was like eating a sardine. 

My husband ordered General Tso's Chicken. Surprise! It wasn't a General Tso's sauce. The chicken was chewy, the sauce was sour and bitter. 

The Crab Rangoons truly are HUGE! And if you like Crab Rangoon for the crab then you don't want to order these, it's mostly just cream cheese. Personally, I love cream cheese. But I didn't order fried wontons with cream cheese. 

I can't believe we spent $30 for this food + delivery. The delivery experience was excellent, I'm very happy with that service. But I would never recommend this place. It was our first & now our

Okay first time coming to Tibbys wanted to try it out. Cause my husband and I are always looking for new place , still being new to the area. So we tried their shrimp and gator cheesecake. It came out looking like a carrot cake lol but not bad of a taste. The bread could
Have been more fresh the bread was cold. So my husband and I ordered the PO Boy with shrimp and Oysters now it's also wasn't bad either I like the sauce that was on it. Now our server realized that I didn't have a lot of shrimp my portion of my sandwich I wasn't going to say anything cause I don't eat a lot as it is and I appreciated that he looked out. Manager came over and brought us out a plate of shrimp for my sandwich again I don't eat a lot and had to take them home one thing I will definitely say the shrimp was fresh. The SERVICE WAS GREAT except for the fact that our server was a Patriots fan that's a heck nah  but other then that perfect customer service. I gave 4 stars for the service mainly and the food a few it wasn't to bad maybe another dish I need to try

Mane - never heard of this place before but I'm glad I'm not into corporate food chains. 

P.O.C. surprised me and I'm glad. Until someplace else pops up - this will be my spot in Santa Barbara.
The chef himself gave our dog a doggy bag. AND the food was absolutely fantastic. I just came back from Israel, but this is better than anywhere I went there.

The food here is always good if that's what you're in the mood for. I went and sat at a really beautiful back patio that I assume is only for reservations if you want to check it out. My only issue was with the service. Our server was hard to track down and didn't really ever check in. Still, times are hard for everyone and we enjoyed our meal so it was a nice treat.

My family has always enjoyed the Great American Pub - it has been our 'go-to' now that we can't 'go-anywhere' it has become our 'to go'.  Ordering is easy - the food is always delicious & consistent & the staff has been accommodating and cheerful!  Cheers and many thanks to the team for making 'now' seem 'normal'.

I was very excited to try this new restaurant after receiving their brochure in my mail.  Two minutes after walking in, I wished I hadn't bothered. While both persons behind the counter lacked any personality and warmth, the young lady was downright sullen and rude. The food is passable, but the lack of even a modicum of a welcoming atmosphere makes this restaurant a."one and done" for me.  Don't bother.  You deserve better.

Came here while visiting friends and had a blast trying all of the drinks they have to offer. 

Highly recommend sitting at the bar if you get the chance so you can watch them craft each one as orders come in. Bartenders are friendly and easy to talk to, very open to making drinks for you or listening to what you like and don't like. 

I had the chocolate cold press drink. Highly recommend! I also had the espresso martini and it was delicious. I was super uncertain about Jameson being in it but they encouraged me it would taste as expected and I loved it. 

We also ordered the truffle popcorn for a late night snack and it was amazing. Definitely order some! 

Get the password before hand or you won't get let in. Such a fun spot. Hidden, speakeasy vibe!

Really glad we got to come back to try since we were in the area,  it was our first time dining in during the pandemic and it a very enjoyable experience with proper measures taken. All the side dishes came in separate plates and meal tray with dividers, very organized set up! Unless you're a family,  they will put them out to share per usual if you're comfortable. Everyone received a bottle water instead of cup too, though I'm not a proponent for wasting plastic like that but understandable given the circumstances. All tables were 6 feet apart with everyone in mask too 

Flavor was great and loved the food once again, still one of my fav soondubu places. 

However disappoint that again our orders were messed up with the level of spiciness that we had to trade it back in. The staff was very friendly and helpful though. Overall it was a gooooood first time dining out experience!
Variety in their menu however it is obvious canned chicken is used. Margaritas are below average; however, just my opinion. Not your taco Tuesday go to if you asked me. ‍

Fritanga is a hidden gem located right near Russell on Jefferson Ave in the McKinley Heights neighborhood. The family who runs this restaurant are some of the friendliest people I've met in STL,  and oh geez the food is GREAT! 
Honestly the portions are super big so I tend to stick with an appetizer and maybe one side...which leaves me with more than enough to enjoy later as well.
Favorite is definitely Chancho con Yuca, which is shredded marinated pork on a bed of yuca with shredded cabbage slaw. (The slaw is not typical coleslaw thank goodness....and it adds a great fresh lightness to the dish)
Also make sure to try their fresh tamarindo juice, super good!

I was not happy with the Sicilian pizza I ordered. There was barely any sauce and the mozzarella cheese seemed weird, like it wasn't real cheese. I'm sure it was but even reheating it, it was kinda transparent. I did enjoy the salad but I guess you can't really get a bad salad. The lasagna was the best out of all. I had a taste from my daughter and that was pretty good. Just was disappointed after spending over $40 to enjoy a salad and a taste of lasagna

I don't know why I waited so long to try this place. It really does live up to the hype! The vegetable dumplings were beautifully wrapped and packed with flavorful veggies. I loved the minced onions in the fried cheese wontons, and the spring rolls were very fresh, seasoned well, and a bit garlicky (in the best way). The only thing I wouldn't order again is the scallion pancakes - they were a bit too chewy.
Best ever pizza. Loved loved it. We did take out but, would love to dine in next time to enjoy all the corky things inside!

Went for dinner but left after ordering drinks because the only staff member in the whole restaurant actually wearing a mask was the bartender and he didn't even make our drinks. We watched an employee prepare our drinks without a mask on while the others hung out at around the bar together also not in their masks. Food runners were coming out with food with no masks so we opted out of eating. Definitely not the place to go right now given their lack of safety measures. Menus were clearly being reused as they had food spilled on them and then were given to us. Servers also were not attentive- they were more interested in mingling with each other at the bar opposed to checking on customers.

My bf and I went for the jazz brunch. I selected table by the trio when i made the reservation but no one took care of that at all. 
The had a pretty wide range of food selections, but they were not as amazing as expected. I liked the turtle soup a lot tho. Atmosphere was nice, service was good too.
